name: MKT_IMP_VENDOR_PROFILES
description: This interface table stores staging data for the marketing vendor's delivery profile and the parameters for that delivery profile.  The data gets populated into MKT_TM_DLV_PROFILE and  MKT_TM_DLV_PRF_PARAMS tables.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups records into a batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key -  Interface Row ID. Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the record being processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the Insert or Update Action that was performed for the record

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File Record Number. Record indicator in the File.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: VENDOR_EXT_REF
columns.description: Vendor Original System Reference for this vendor profile record. Used to lookup VENDOR_ID.

columns.name: VENDOR_DLV_PROF_EXT_REF
columns.description: Vendor Delivery Profile OSR Id for this vendor profile record. Used to lookup DELV_PROFILE_ID. Maps to MKT_TM_DLV_PROFILE.DELV_PROFILE_NUMBER column in the Fusion Base table.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Fusion Id of Vendor for this vendor profile record

columns.name: DELV_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Fusion Id of Vendor Delivery Profile

columns.name: PARAM_ID
columns.description: Fusion Id of Vendor Delivery Profile Param

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: Channel Type for the delivery profile

columns.name: SUPPORTED_CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: Treatment channel used for supported channel type

columns.name: BATCH_SIZE
columns.description: Vendor Profile Batch Size for this vendor profile record

columns.name: START_DT
columns.description: Start Date for this vendor profile record

columns.name: END_DT
columns.description: End Date for this vendor profile record

columns.name: CAPACITY_QTY
columns.description: Capacity Quantity for this vendor profile record

columns.name: CAPACITY_REPT_FREQ
columns.description: Capacity Repeat Frequency for this vendor profile record

columns.name: CAPACITY_REPT_UNIT_CD
columns.description: Capacitry Repeat Unit for this vendor profile record

columns.name: PROFILE_NAME
columns.description: Vendor Profile Name for this vendor profile record

columns.name: DLV_PROFILE_STATUS
columns.description: Delivery Profile Status for this vendor profile record

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Vendor Profile Active Flag for this vendor profile record

columns.name: DLV_DESC_TEXT
columns.description: Delivery Profile Description for this vendor profile record

columns.name: PARAM_NAME
columns.description: Parameter Name for this vendor profile record

columns.name: PARAM_VALUE
columns.description: Parameter Value for this vendor profile record

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
